title: Assay of topoisomerase I activity
author: Yuan Yao
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.p99dr96
materials: Photograph the gel illuminated with a UV transilluminator.

steps.title: Prepare reaction mixture
steps.instruction: Add 2 μl of 10× topoisomerase I reaction buffer and 400 ng pUC19 plasmid DNA (Takara, Japan) to each 1.5‑ml microcentrifuge tube on ice, then adjust with distilled water so the total volume (including later‑added protein) is 20 μl.

substeps.instruction: Add distilled water to reach 20 μl final volume.

steps.title: Add enzyme and incubate
steps.instruction: Add the desired amount of purified RstA or one unit of E. coli topoisomerase I protein (NEB, USA) to each tube, mix, and incubate for 10 min at 37 °C.

substeps.instruction: Add purified RstA (various amounts) or 1 unit of E. coli topoisomerase I.

steps.title: Add loading dye and electrophorese
steps.instruction: Add 4 μl of 6× loading dye to each tube, load the entire reaction onto a 0.8 % agarose gel, and run the gel for 2 h at 5–10 V/cm.

substeps.instruction: Load the reaction onto a 0.8 % agarose gel.
Run the gel for 2 h at 5–10 V/cm.

steps.title: Stain and destain gel
steps.instruction: Stain the gel with ethidium bromide, then briefly destain with water.
